description: This file implements functionality to replace variable shadowing in an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) for shader code, specifically handling nested scope variable redefinitions in ESSL shaders. It defines classes and functions to traverse the AST, identify redefinitions, and perform replacements.

classes.name: ReplaceShadowingVariablesTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the AST to identify variable shadowing and queue replacements for later execution.

methods.name: ReplaceShadowingVariables
methods.description: Main function to replace all shadowed variable references in the AST.
